systems.owner: Directorate of Nationality, Passports and Immigration, Ministry of Interior
systems.tiers: headquarters in Juba, local branches in the ten states and designated embassies, as the regulations provide

systems.owner: Directorate of Nationality, Passports and Immigration

note: Nationality regulations of 2011. Paragraph 83 mandates a register of nationals recording personal details including civil status, and notes that the Constitution (Schedule B no. 16) gives the states exclusive power over registration of birth, death, marriage and divorce; a birth certificate is only a supporting document for a nationality application. Nothing on how a birth or death is registered or on the form of any record.
